title: Browser findings: 62M, 8% weight loss by recorded weights, full work-up, exam NAD - the note supports P2 once malignancy suspicion is attested
note: 62M, 4/12 unintentional weight loss 84->77kg (8%) on scales, bloods/urinalysis/CXR done and normal, exam NAD. Requesting CT chest abdomen pelvis.

expectedAbsent.workup.strongSuspicionMalignancy: Attestation-category indicator (AD-17). The extraction model must never answer it - the referrer attests it in the Triage Advisor. 'Requesting CT chest abdomen pelvis' is a request, not a stated strong suspicion of malignancy.
expectedAbsent.advice.urgentCTRecommended: No secondary-care / PCRL / radiologist advice is mentioned.
expectedAbsent.symptom.abdominalPain: No symptom is stated. 'exam NAD' is a normal examination, not a symptom.

provenance.source: arch-mig browser-testing session against the thin Triage pipeline page (chore/arch-mig-browser-findings-1)
provenance.noteProvenance: constructed for this session from the browser finding; no patient-identifiable data.
provenance.evaluatorExpectation: P2_URGENT. The note gives everything the CT CAP P2 pathway B1 needs - male over 50, 8% documented weight loss over 4 months by recorded weights, full initial work-up, no localising features - EXCEPT the practitioner's attested strong suspicion of malignancy.
provenance.divergence: The extraction-only benchmark path (`/api/assess/extract` -> `/api/assess/evaluate`) cannot supply `workup.strongSuspicionMalignancy` (AD-17: attestation-only), so the engine returns INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION. `engineExpectation` records that. The full pipeline reaches P2_URGENT only when the referrer attests it - the same mechanism `tests/scenarios.mjs` S01 and the pipeline-e2e demonstration case cover. This case's value is the EXTRACTION score: it exercises E-04 (`4/12` -> 4 months), E-07 (`exam NAD` -> `workup.localisingFeatures` false), E-08 (`on scales` -> `weightloss.measured`), the new `weightloss.weightBefore` / `weightloss.weightNow` indicators, a stated percentage alongside recorded weights, and the attestation indicator staying unanswered.
